title: NOAA current-station bundle
description: Tidal-current stations extracted from NOAA CO-OPS metadata. Harmonic stations carry their own constituents; subordinate stations reduce against a harmonic reference. Speeds are knots, directions degrees true, time offsets seconds.

crossFlow.description: Census of NOAA `minorMeanSpeed` — flow perpendicular to the flood axis, present at all times including slack. This bundle's major-axis model drops it; this records how much it drops. Not carried per station. Null when the bundle has no harmonic stations.

worstRatio.description: Largest crossFlow/alongAxisPeak — where the flood axis describes the station worst.

alongAxisPeak.description: Σ|majorAmplitude| + |Z0| — a theoretical maximum reached only if every constituent aligned in phase, not a realized peak speed. The denominator `ratio` and the 0.5 bound are only meaningful given this definition.

worstAbsolute.description: Largest crossFlow in knots — usually a different station from worstRatio.

id.description: NOAA station id at its primary bin, or `id@bin` for a reference at a non-primary bin. Constituents vary by depth bin, so identity is (station, bin).

offset.description: Z0 — net mean flow along the major axis, knots, signed (NOAA `majorMeanSpeed`). A DC offset on the velocity curve; omitting it moves every slack.

reference.description: `id` of the harmonic station in this bundle to reduce against — including the `@bin` suffix when the reference is at a non-primary bin.

slackBeforeFloodOffset.description: Seconds. Applied to a slack that precedes a flood.

slackBeforeEbbOffset.description: Seconds. Applied to a slack that precedes an ebb.

floodSpeedRatio.description: Multiplier on the reference max flood speed. A ratio, not a delta.

ebbSpeedRatio.description: Multiplier on the reference max ebb speed.
